name: Colonel Santosh Babu
real_life_parallel: 16 Bihar CO killed at Galwan June 2020; posthumous Maha Vir Chakra

biography.background: Commanding Officer, 16 Bihar Regiment. Led troops during Galwan Valley clash 15 June 2020. Killed in hand-to-hand combat with PLA at 14,000 feet. Posthumous Maha Vir Chakra.
biography.death_circumstances: Attempted to negotiate de-escalation; overwhelmed by PLA numbers; fought to death
biography.galwan_context: First Indian CO killed in action since 1971; 20 Indian soldiers killed total
biography.film_relevance: Part 4: Galwan centerpiece; sacrifice representation; China front opening
